stem.text: A cell of constant electromotive force (e.m.f.) and negligible internal resistance is separately connected into four different circuits.
In which circuit does the power dissipated by the lamp stay the same as the variable resistor is adjusted?

A.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell, a lamp and a variable resistor, with the lamp and variable resistor in parallel.

B.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell, a lamp and a variable resistor in a single loop.

C.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell, a lamp, a variable resistor and a fixed resistor, with the variable resistor and fixed resistor in parallel.

D.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell, a fixed resistor, a lamp and a variable resistor, with the variable resistor and lamp in parallel.
